sentences.text:
Smt. Minakshi Bhati W/O Shri Bhavdeep ... vs Bhavdeep Bhati
S/O Shri Narendra Singh ... on 16 February, 2023
Author: Sameer Jain

Bench: Sameer Jain [2023/RJJP/002938]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Civil Transfer Application No. 83/2019 Smt. Minakshi Bhati W/o Shri Bhavdeep Bhati D/o Shri Shivprakash Sisodia, Aged About 30 Years, R/o At Present 61/23, Pratap Nagar, Sanganer, Jaipur (Raj)
 ----Petitioner  Versus Bhavdeep Bhati S/o Shri Narendra Singh Bhati, Aged About 32 Years, R/o Himdasaria House, Vivekanand Marg, Hanuman Dhora, Sujangarh, Churu, (Raj)
 ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Ms. Vandana Sharma

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : None  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN  Order 16/02/2023 1.

This transfer application has been filed by the applicant-wife under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of Case No. 222/2018 titled as Bhavdeep Bhati Vs. Minakshi Sisodia,
filed by the non-applicant-husband under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 from Family Court, Churu to Family Court, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur.
2. At the outset, it is pertinent to note that despite effective service upon the non-applicant, none has marked their presence on his behalf.
In the interest of justice, the matter is being taken up for final disposal.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has prayed for the transfer of the case, primarily on the following grounds:
Smt. Minakshi Bhati W/O Shri Bhavdeep ... vs Bhavdeep Bhati S/O Shri Narendra Singh ... on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41525604/
1 (i) That the applicant is presently residing in District Jaipur.

(ii) That multiple cases, arising out of the matrimonial relationship, are pending adjudication in District Jaipur; including a case under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act along with a complaint under Section(s) 498A, 406 and 323 of IPC.
(iii) That the applicant does not have the infrastructural support, in terms of family members, who can accompany her to court proceedings pending in Churu.
(iv) That the applicant has the responsibility to look after her minor daughter.
(v) That the applicant is financially deprived with no independent source of income.

4. Considering the contentions put forth by the learned counsel for the applicant and considering the fact that multiple proceedings arising out of the marriage are pending adjudication in District Jaipur; that the applicant is presently residing in District Jaipur as well; that the applicant is an unemployed woman, with no source of livelihood; that the applicant has the responsibility to look after her minor daughter; considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgments of the Apex Court in N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha:
Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022, Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.: AIR 2002 SC 396, Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi: (2005) 12 SCC 237, and Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap Vs.
Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap: AIR 2016 SC 3584, this Court deems it just and proper to transfer the Case No. 222/2018 from Family Court, Churu to Family Court, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the present transfer application is allowed.
The Case No. 222/2018 be transfered from Family Court, Churu to Family Court, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur.
6. Both parties are directed to appear before the transferee court on 09.03.2023.
By that time, the record of the case be transmitted to the transferee Court by the Court concerned.
It is made clear that if any of the parties would not appear on the date fixed by this Court, the transferee court would be at liberty to proceed in accordance with law.

7. It is expected that the transferee court shall dispose of the matter as expeditiously as possible;
preferably within the prescribed time period as stipulated in the Act.
8. Stay application and other pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
